#### Purpose of this file  

This file contains all of the code for producing a curated OTU table from the 16S microbial sequence data for the Armstrong et al. manuscript.

The goal is to perform community level diversity analyses simplified across a symmetric 3-node experimental design common to both hosts.

Load necessary R packages and set default parameters

# 1.4 - Load Phyloseq Object & Implement Simplified Meta-Structure

```{r 1.4-load-ps}
# a - Load physeq ----
  load(paste(dir_in, 
             "03-AAC-PhylogeneticTree/", 
             "03-AAC-PhylogeneticTree_physeq_midpointTree.RData", 
             sep = ""))

# b - Perform targeted curation: Filter genotypes, drop 2-weeks, and collapse 4-months/Pre-HS nodes ----
  metadata_raw <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_midpointTree)) %>%
    mutate(SampleID_Temp = rownames(.)) %>%
    # CRITICAL FIX: Force metadata columns to text strings to prevent factor numeric encoding bugs
    mutate(
      Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
      Host = as.character(Host)
    ) %>%
    # 1. Drop 2-Week samples completely to establish inter-species symmetry
    filter(Treatment != "2-Weeks") %>%
    # 2. Handle the Pocillopora genotype duality: Drop original POC "Genotype" rows
    filter(!(Host == "POC" & Treatment == "Genotype")) %>%
    # 3. Rename Genotype2 to Genotype for POC so both species share identical baseline text
    mutate(Treatment = ifelse(Host == "POC" & Treatment == "Genotype2", "Genotype", Treatment)) %>%
    # 4. Merge simultaneous chronological samplings into a single Treatment factor node
    mutate(Treatment = ifelse(Treatment %in% c("4-Months", "Pre-HS"), "4-Month-Pre-HS", Treatment)) %>%
    # Convert back into an explicit factor for downstream modeling
    mutate(Treatment = as.factor(Treatment))

  # Re-apply clean metadata subset matrix back onto parent phyloseq infrastructure
  physeq_pruned <- prune_samples(metadata_raw$SampleID_Temp, physeq_midpointTree)
  sample_data(physeq_pruned) <- sample_data(metadata_raw)

# c - Add a column to the metadata listing the full treatment condition ----
  sample_data(physeq_pruned)$FullTreatment <- paste(
    sample_data(physeq_pruned)$Site,
    sample_data(physeq_pruned)$Subtype,
    sample_data(physeq_pruned)$Transplant,
    sample_data(physeq_pruned)$Treatment,
    sep = " "
  )

# d - Fix the duplicate colony labels by combining Host and Colony names ----
  metadata_clean <- as(sample_data(physeq_pruned), "data.frame") %>%
    mutate(
      Unique_Colony = case_when(
        Type == "Coral" ~ paste0(Host, "_", Colony),
        TRUE ~ "Environmental_Ref"
      )
    )

# e - Re-assign the corrected metadata back into your workspace tree object ----
  sample_data(physeq_pruned) <- sample_data(metadata_clean)
  physeq_midpointTree <- physeq_pruned
```


## 2.3 - Determine Minimum Read Depth and Remove Low Sequence Samples
```{r 2.3-rarefaction-filter}
# a - what is the minimum number of sequences? ---- 
  physeq_midpointTree %>%
    sample_sums() %>%
    min()

# b - Visualize the rarefaction curves to assess coverage ----
  if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_midpointTree)) {
    OTU_table <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(physeq_midpointTree)))
  } else {
    OTU_table <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_midpointTree))
  }

  plot_rareCurves <- 
    rarecurve(OTU_table, 
              step = 50, 
              col = "black", label = FALSE, main = "Rarefaction Curves")

# c - Identify samples that haven't reached the asymptote ----
  data_rareCurves <- 
    lapply(seq_along(plot_rareCurves), 
           function(i) {
             x <- attr(plot_rareCurves[[i]], "Subsample")
             y <- plot_rareCurves[[i]]
             data.frame(Sample = rownames(OTU_table)[i], x = x, y = y)
           })
  df_rareCurves <- do.call(rbind, data_rareCurves)

# d - Calculate the slope of the last 3 points for each curve ---
  slope_check <- 
    df_rareCurves %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    filter(x >= (max(x) - 150)) %>% 
    summarise(Slope = (dplyr::last(y) - dplyr::first(y)) / 
                (dplyr::last(x) - dplyr::first(x)))

# e - Flag samples with a slope greater than 0.05 new species per read ----
  samples_unreachedAsymptote <- 
    slope_check %>%
    filter(Slope > 0.05) %>%
    pull(Sample)
  
  print(samples_unreachedAsymptote)
  
# f - Remove low reads, outliers, and flagged non-asymptote samples ----
  
  # 1. First drop the low read samples
  physeq_noLow <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_midpointTree) >= 2000, physeq_midpointTree)
  
  # 2. Combine your manual outliers and your slope-flagged samples into one list
  exclude_samples <- c("71-TTC04F40POR", "24-TGC04F00POR", samples_unreachedAsymptote)
  
  # 3. Filter out the specific outlier/unreached asymptote samples safely
  physeq_subset <- subset_samples(physeq_noLow, !(sample_names(physeq_noLow) %in% exclude_samples))
  
  # 4. Remove ASVs/OTUs that now have 0 total reads across your remaining samples
  physeq_midpointTree_curated <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq_subset) > 0, physeq_subset)

  # how many samples were removed?
  cat("Total samples removed during curation:", nsamples(physeq_midpointTree) - nsamples(physeq_midpointTree_curated), "\n")
  
  # what proportion of samples remain?
  cat("Proportion of remaining high-quality samples:", nsamples(physeq_midpointTree_curated)/nsamples(physeq_midpointTree), "\n")
```

# 3 - Normalize Read Counts
## 3.1 - Create the scale_reads function
```{r 3.1-scale-function}
  matround <- function(x){trunc(x+0.5)}
  
  scale_reads <- 
    function(physeq, n = min(sample_sums(physeq)), round = "round") 
      {
      physeq.scale <- transform_sample_counts(physeq, function(x) {(n * x/sum(x))})
      
      if (round == "floor"){
        otu_table(physeq.scale) <- floor(otu_table(physeq.scale))
        } else if (round == "round"){
          otu_table(physeq.scale) <- round(otu_table(physeq.scale))
          } else if (round == "matround"){
            otu_table(physeq.scale) <- matround(otu_table(physeq.scale))
            }
      
      physeq.scale <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq.scale) > 0, physeq.scale)
      return(physeq.scale)
      }
```

## 3.2 - Scale the reads and check the distribution of the seq depth
```{r 3.2-apply-scaling}
# a - Scale reads across global and host-isolated environments ----
    physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled <- scale_reads(physeq_midpointTree_curated, round = "matround")

    physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR <- subset_samples(physeq_midpointTree_curated, Host == "POR")

    physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled <- scale_reads(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC, round = "matround")
    physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled <- scale_reads(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR, round = "matround")

# b - Calculate and inspect the read depth profiles ----
    df_scaled_TotalSeqs <- data.frame(TotalSeqs = sample_sums(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled))
    df_scaled_POC_TotalSeqs <- data.frame(TotalSeqs = sample_sums(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled))

df_scaled_POR_TotalSeqs <- data.frame(TotalSeqs = sample_sums(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled))
cat("Optimized Pocillopora sequencing depth target:", min(df_scaled_POC_TotalSeqs$TotalSeqs), "\n")
cat("Optimized Porites sequencing depth target:", min(df_scaled_POR_TotalSeqs$TotalSeqs), "\n")
# c - Confirm depth target range profiles flat (delta should equal zero) ----
cat("Global comparative Target Range Delta:", max(df_scaled_TotalSeqs$TotalSeqs) - min(df_scaled_TotalSeqs$TotalSeqs), "\n")
```

4.2 - Ordinations & 3-Node Timeline Visualizations
```{r 4.2-ordinations-and-plotting}
a - Create a Function that will perform all Ordinations ----
generate_ordinations <- function(physeq, plot_label = "Dataset") {
soren_dist <- phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "bray", binary = TRUE)
soren_pcoa <- ordinate(physeq, method = "PCoA", distance = soren_dist)
bray_pcoa  <- ordinate(physeq, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")
unifrac_unw_pcoa <- ordinate(physeq, method = "PCoA", distance = "unifrac")
unifrac_w_pcoa <- ordinate(physeq, method = "PCoA", distance = "wunifrac")
unifrac_w_nmds   <- ordinate(physeq, method = "NMDS", distance = "wunifrac")
return(list(
Soren_PCoA    = soren_pcoa,
Bray_PCoA     = bray_pcoa,
Unifrac_PCoA  = unifrac_unw_pcoa,
WUnifrac_PCoA = unifrac_w_pcoa,
WUnifrac_NMDS = unifrac_w_nmds
))
}
b - Run the ordination functions on the 3-node datasets ----
ords_combined <- generate_ordinations(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled, "Global")
ords_POC      <- generate_ordinations(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled, "POC")
ords_POR      <- generate_ordinations(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled, "POR")
c - Define 3-Node Timeline Plotting Functions ----
make_ordination_plots_patchwork <- function(physeq, ord_list, title_prefix) {
p1 <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_list$Soren_PCoA, color = "Subtype", shape = "Site") +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Sørensen (PCoA)")
p2 <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_list$Bray_PCoA, color = "Subtype", shape = "Site") +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Bray-Curtis (PCoA)")
p3 <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_list$Unifrac_PCoA, color = "Subtype", shape = "Site") +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Unweighted UniFrac (PCoA)")
p4 <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_list$WUnifrac_PCoA, color = "Subtype", shape = "Site") +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Weighted UniFrac (PCoA)")
stress_val <- round(ord_list$WUnifrac_NMDS$stress, 3)
p5 <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_list$WUnifrac_NMDS, color = "Subtype", shape = "Site") +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6) + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Weighted UniFrac (NMDS)") +
annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("NMDS Stress =", stress_val), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic")
(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / (p5 + patchwork::plot_spacer()) +
plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
plot_annotation(title = paste(title_prefix, "- Multiple Ordination Framework"), theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)))
}
make_host_trajectory_plot_patchwork <- function(physeq, ord_list, host_name) {
# FIX: Enforce symmetric, streamlined 3-node timeline levels explicitly for tracking lines
sample_data(physeq)$Treatment <- factor(sample_data(physeq)$Treatment, levels = c("Genotype", "4-Month-PreHS", "Post-HS"))
p_build <- function(ord_obj, dist_title, is_nmds = FALSE) {
p <- plot_ordination(physeq, ord_obj, color = "Site", shape = "Treatment") +
geom_path(aes(group = Unique_Colony), color = "grey75", arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "cm")), alpha = 0.5) +
geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.7) +
stat_ellipse(aes(group = Site), alpha = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") + theme_bw() + labs(title = dist_title)
if(is_nmds) {
stress_val <- round(ord_obj$stress, 3)
p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("NMDS Stress =", stress_val), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic")
}
return(p)
}
p1 <- p_build(ord_list$Soren_PCoA, "Sørensen (PCoA)")
p2 <- p_build(ord_list$Bray_PCoA, "Bray-Curtis (PCoA)")
p3 <- p_build(ord_list$Unifrac_PCoA, "Unweighted UniFrac (PCoA)")
p4 <- p_build(ord_list$WUnifrac_PCoA, "Weighted UniFrac (PCoA)")
p5 <- p_build(ord_list$WUnifrac_NMDS, "Weighted UniFrac (NMDS)", is_nmds = TRUE)
(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / (p5 + patchwork::plot_spacer()) +
plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
plot_annotation(
title = paste(host_name, "- Genotype Trajectories Across Sites & Stress"),
subtitle = "Arrows trace individual fragments across a symmetric 3-node experimental design",
theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5))
)
}
d - Render Visualizations ----
make_ordination_plots_patchwork(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled, ords_combined, "Global")
print(make_host_trajectory_plot_patchwork(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled, ords_POC, "Pocillopora (POC)"))
print(make_host_trajectory_plot_patchwork(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled, ords_POR, "Porites (POR)"))
```

5 - Statistical Significance Testing
5.1 - Global Macro-PERMANOVA
```{r 5.1-global-permanova}
run_global_permanova_table <- function(physeq) {
physeq_clean <- subset_samples(physeq, Group == "TrueSample")
metadata_all <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_clean))
dist_list <- list(
Sorensen = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "bray", binary = TRUE),
Bray_Curtis = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "bray", binary = FALSE),
Unweighted_UniFrac = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "unifrac"),
Weighted_UniFrac = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "wunifrac")
)
permanova_tables <- lapply(names(dist_list), function(metric_name) {
res <- adonis2(dist_list[[metric_name]] ~ Subtype * Site, data = metadata_all, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
as.data.frame(res) %>%
mutate(Metric = metric_name, Term = rownames(.)) %>%
select(Metric, Term, Df, SumOfSqs, F, R2, Pr(>F))
})
bind_rows(permanova_tables) %>% filter(Term %in= c("Subtype", "Site", "Subtype:Site"))
}
global_results_table <- run_global_permanova_table(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled)
print(global_results_table)
```

5.3 - Global Pairwise Post-Hocs
```{r 5.3-pairwise-posthoc}
run_pairwise_subtypes <- function(physeq) {
physeq_clean <- subset_samples(physeq, Group == "TrueSample")
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_clean))
dist_list <- list(
Sorensen = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "bray", binary = TRUE),
Bray_Curtis = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "bray", binary = FALSE),
Unweighted_UniFrac = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "unifrac"),
Weighted_UniFrac = phyloseq::distance(physeq_clean, method = "wunifrac")
)
lapply(names(dist_list), function(metric_name) {
res <- pairwise.adonis2(dist_list[[metric_name]] ~ Subtype, data = metadata, p.adjust.m = "fdr")
comp_names <- names(res)[names(res) != "parent_call"]
lapply(comp_names, function(comp) {
df_comp <- as.data.frame(res[[comp]])
data.frame(Metric = metric_name, Comparison = comp, R2 = df_comp$R2[1], P_adj = df_comp$Pr(>F)[1])
}) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()
}
subtype_pairwise_table <- run_pairwise_subtypes(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled)
print(subtype_pairwise_table %>% filter(grepl("Coral POC|Coral POR", Comparison)))
```
5.4 - Streamlined Genotype-Blocked Host PERMANOVAs
```{r 5.4-host-permanova}
run_host_permanova_table <- function(physeq, host_label) {
metadata_host <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq))
dist_list <- list(
Sorensen = phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "bray", binary = TRUE),
Bray_Curtis = phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "bray", binary = FALSE),
Unweighted_UniFrac = phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "unifrac"),
Weighted_UniFrac   = phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "wunifrac")
)
perm_control <- how(
blocks = metadata_host$Unique_Colony,
plots = Plots(strata = metadata_host$Unique_Colony, type = "none"),
within = Within(type = "free"), nperm = 999
)
permanova_tables <- lapply(names(dist_list), function(metric_name) {
res <- adonis2(dist_list[[metric_name]] ~ Site * Treatment, data = metadata_host, permutations = perm_control, by = "terms")
as.data.frame(res) %>%
mutate(Metric = metric_name, Term = rownames(.)) %>%
select(Metric, Term, Df, SumOfSqs, F, R2, Pr(>F))
})
bind_rows(permanova_tables) %>% filter(Term %in% c("Site", "Treatment", "Site:Treatment"))
}
cat("\n--- POCILLOPORA SYMMETRIC 3-NODE TIMELINE STATISTICS ---\n")
print(run_host_permanova_table(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled, "Pocillopora"))
cat("\n--- PORITES SYMMETRIC 3-NODE TIMELINE STATISTICS ---\n")
print(run_host_permanova_table(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled, "Porites"))
```

6 - Asymmetrical Environmental Tracking Analysis (Phylogenetic Plasticity)
```{r 6-environmental-tracking}
Dynamic tracking execution mapping out branch line transitions on raw ASVs + tree nodes
coral_subtypes <- c("Coral POC", "Coral POR")
env_medium     <- c("Seawater 0.2-micron", "Seawater 3-micron", "Sediment")
all_raw_shifts <- list()
for (current_coral in coral_subtypes) {
physeq_tracking_combined <- subset_samples(physeq_midpointTree_curated_scaled, Subtype %in% c(current_coral, env_medium))
dist_mat <- as.matrix(distance(physeq_tracking_combined, method = "unifrac", weighted = FALSE))
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_tracking_combined)) %>%
mutate(SampleID = as.character(rownames(.)), Site = as.character(Site), Subtype = as.character(Subtype), Transplant = as.character(Transplant))
coral_samples <- metadata %>% filter(Subtype == current_coral & Transplant == "Out Transplant")
env_samples   <- metadata %>% filter(Subtype %in% env_medium)
if(nrow(coral_samples) == 0) next
sample_vectors <- lapply(1:nrow(coral_samples), function(i) {
t_id   <- coral_samples$SampleID[i]
t_site <- coral_samples$Site[i]
t_origin <- if(t_site == "Tiahura") "Opunohu" else "Tiahura"
coral_dist_vector <- dist_mat[t_id, ]
lapply(env_medium, function(current_env) {
local_env_ids  <- env_samples$SampleID[env_samples$Subtype == current_env & env_samples$Site == t_site]
source_env_ids <- env_samples$SampleID[env_samples$Subtype == current_env & env_samples$Site == t_origin]
if(length(local_env_ids) == 0 | length(source_env_ids) == 0) return(NULL)
local_distances  <- coral_dist_vector[names(coral_dist_vector) %in% local_env_ids]
source_distances <- coral_dist_vector[names(coral_dist_vector) %in% source_env_ids]
data.frame(
SampleID = t_id, Site = t_site, Coral_Host = current_coral, Environmental_Medium = current_env,
To_Local = mean(local_distances, na.rm = TRUE), To_Source = mean(source_distances, na.rm = TRUE)
)
}) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows()
if (nrow(sample_vectors) > 0) { all_raw_shifts[[current_coral]] <- sample_vectors }
}
raw_shifts_df <- bind_rows(all_raw_shifts) %>% mutate(Individual_Shift = To_Source - To_Local)
stats_df <- raw_shifts_df %>%
group_by(Coral_Host, Environmental_Medium, Site) %>%
summarise(P_Value = if(n() >= 3 && sd(Individual_Shift) != 0) wilcox.test(To_Local, To_Source, paired = TRUE)$p.value else NA, .groups = "drop") %>%
mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "fdr"))
plot_tracking_df <- raw_shifts_df %>%
group_by(Coral_Host, Environmental_Medium, Site) %>%
summarise(Mean_Shift = mean(Individual_Shift, na.rm = TRUE), SE_Shift = sd(Individual_Shift, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), Sample_Size = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
left_join(stats_df, by = c("Coral_Host", "Environmental_Medium", "Site")) %>%
mutate(
Environmental_Medium = case_when(Environmental_Medium == "Seawater 0.2-micron" ~ "Free Living Water (0.2µm)", Environmental_Medium == "Seawater 3-micron" ~ "Particle Bound Water (3µm)", TRUE ~ "Benthic Sediment"),
Coral_Host = if_else(Coral_Host == "Coral POC", "Pocillopora (POC)", "Porites (POR)")
)
print(plot_tracking_df)
```
7 - Alpha Diversity & Unified Hill Numbers Analysis
7.1 - Alpha Profile Calculations & Boxplots
```{r 7.1-alpha-modeling}
Evaluate Shannon alpha profiles across the restructured metadata data frames
alpha_poc <- estimate_richness(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
df_alpha_poc <- cbind(data.frame(sample_data(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POC_scaled)), alpha_poc) %>% mutate(Host = "Pocillopora")
alpha_por <- estimate_richness(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon"))
df_alpha_por <- cbind(data.frame(sample_data(physeq_midpointTree_curated_POR_scaled)), alpha_por) %>% mutate(Host = "Porites")
df_alpha_all <- bind_rows(df_alpha_poc, df_alpha_por) %>%
mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Genotype", "4-Month-PreHS", "Post-HS")))
ggplot(df_alpha_all, aes(x = Treatment, y = Shannon, fill = Site)) +
geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
geom_point(aes(color = Site), position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~ Host, scales = "free_x") + theme_bw() +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("Tiahura" = "#377eb8", "Opunohu" = "#e41a1c")) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("Tiahura" = "#225ea8", "Opunohu" = "#cc0000"))
```
